delta.comment: Contract replanning (operator-directed, 2026-08-19): late-identifier reconciliation workflow defined. Closes the dangling obligation where 134.004-T's LATE-SURFACING THREAD criterion delegated reconciliation to "Stage's C6 intake responsibility" with no task defining it, making every threadless `N/A` permanent under the single-write invariant. Added: retrieval from Ship-owned residual-risk records via the deferred entry ID join key, Stage-authority in-place reconciliation (no Ship write, C5 carve-out unweakened), anti-duplication, non-blocking, and idempotence rules. Added dependency on 134.004-T (content ordering, not checksum serialization); 134.007-T deliberately excluded with rationale. Size M -> L for genuine scope growth.

Readiness fix cycle 3 (review of 904c46b9, P1): added dependency on 134.007-T. The prior exclusion rationale was "the fix-ci carrier is threadless by nature -- a review thread never surfaces inside a fix-ci run -- so it originates no late identifier", which reasoned from the false threadless-only premise. fix-ci Step 6.5 re-queries for threads opened during the fix phase, so a CI finding captured with review-thread ID N/A can gain a thread inside the same run; fix-ci therefore originates late identifiers and its run/closure records are a retrieval source this task must name. RETRIEVAL SOURCE criterion updated accordingly. Content ordering edge only - 134.007-T is template-only with no dogfood or manifest entry, so hardening H4 serialization does not apply.
